title.narrative: Strengthening Government Capacities on AI and Digital Transformation

description.narrative: Digital transformation and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are reshaping public administration globally. Governments increasingly require skilled civil servants capable of leveraging AI and digital technologies responsibly, effectively and in alignment with ethical principles, human rights and sustainable development objectives. To support this transition, UNESCO has developed the MOOC on AI and Digital Transformation in Government and the UNESCO Competency Framework on AI and Digital Transformation in Government. These resources provide a comprehensive and scalable learning pathway for public officials and institutions seeking to strengthen digital governance capacities. UNESCO can support Member States by combining comprehensive assessment of digital environment and formulation of evidence-driven policy-recommendations, competency frameworks, scalable online learning, in-person training, data governance support and partnerships with schools of public administration so that digital transformation is inclusive, rights-based and institutionally sustainable. This project aims to build the capacities of 60 civil servants through a blended learning approach combining self-paced online learning and face-to-face training workshops delivered in partnership with national stakeholders.
